playerText.title: Open Orders I: Work Worth Doing
playerText.summary: Choose how the Breckenridge will help the Reach while the Hecate evidence is correlated in the background.

playerText.label: Compact Verification Framework
playerText.summary: A functioning Compact-Starfleet channel can compare disputed records under bounded access. It does not guarantee trust, agreement, or a favorable finding.

playerText.label: Medical Supply Accountability
playerText.summary: The Breckenridge has recent experience distinguishing useful informal logistics from undocumented access and diverted medical supply. That history sharpens scrutiny without implicating the Quiet Channels network in redline.
The Long Repair, Borrowed Wings, and Quiet Channels are available. Resolving two is a normal command load; taking on all three requires credible delegation or risks overextension.

The Breckenridge's remaining technical debt is ordinary accumulated work rather than sabotage; the ship can become safer through honest priorities, documented limits, and bounded Helix Yard support without pretending every system is fully repaired.

The civilian pilots have useful local experience but uneven preparation; a credible rescue capability depends on honest qualification, command, escort, and abort limits rather than treating them as Starfleet crew.

The informal channels are primarily ordinary mutual-aid relationships, not a spy network, but favors and insecure traffic can create real institutional obligations that require bounded authority and accountability.

values.guidance: The player explicitly commits to direct command involvement.

The player explicitly declines or leaves the assignment unpursued for this interval.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts a completed, usable technical-debt and support assessment after direct engagement or delegation.
exclusions: Selecting the assignment, scheduling a review, assigning engineers, or inspecting one isolated issue does not complete the assessment.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates the aggregate assessment: ordinary technical debt, achievable safety gains without fictional full repair, and the need for honest priorities, limits, and bounded yard support.
exclusions: A single ship issue, a repair order, a suspicion of sabotage, or a generic readiness concern does not disclose the aggregate assessment.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the actual final disposition of The Long Repair after the assessment is player-known.

values.guidance: An accountable stabilization plan is committed and Helix Yard Support is actually secured.
The immediate technical-debt problem receives a responsible but materially limited disposition without the full support asset.
The assignment materially fails after the known technical risk and limits are deliberately mishandled or rejected.

exclusions: Selecting, delegating, starting repairs, naming priorities, or negotiating without a committed disposition does not establish the result.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Dev Adebayo and Imani expose a combined-load limit that is individually within certification but unsafe under the proposed repair plan, forcing priorities, a bounded deferral, delegation, or overreach.
exclusions: The opening assessment, one routine repair, a plan that has not met a load limit, or generic technical debt is not the complication.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts a completed, usable assessment of pilots, craft, route conditions, qualifications, command, escort, and abort needs.
exclusions: Selecting the assignment, meeting one pilot, opening training, or running one unassessed exercise does not complete the assessment.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates the aggregate assessment: useful local experience, uneven preparation, and the need for honest qualification, command, escort, and abort limits.
exclusions: One pilot's performance, a training order, a hidden-compromise theory, or generic praise does not disclose the aggregate assessment.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the actual final disposition of Borrowed Wings after the assessment is player-known.

values.guidance: A credible qualified capability is demonstrated and the Civilian Rescue Wing is actually established.
A useful but materially restricted pilot capability or alternative route is responsibly established without the full asset.
The assignment materially fails after known qualification, command, or abort risks are deliberately mishandled.

exclusions: Selecting, delegating, beginning training, passing one exercise, or declaring the pilots ready does not establish the result.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Lena Ors's sensor-triggered trauma response is disclosed by her, observed under controlled conditions, or surfaces during training and must be separated from her overall ability.
exclusions: A rumor, diagnosis without observed duty relevance, Kieran's suspicion, or ordinary training difficulty is not the complication.

values.guidance: The player explicitly commits to direct command involvement.

exclusions: Interest, discussion, a request for more information, or an assignment appearing in a list is not an engagement decision.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts a completed, usable assessment of the contact network, favors, verification practices, insecure traffic, and authority obligations.
exclusions: Selecting the assignment, contacting one person, receiving one message, or mapping one favor does not complete the assessment.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose communicates the aggregate assessment: ordinary mutual-aid relationships rather than a spy front, with favors and insecure traffic creating real obligations that need bounded authority.
exclusions: One favor, one compromised message, a Pale Lantern theory, or a general warning about informal channels does not disclose the aggregate assessment.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when accepted assistant prose depicts the actual final disposition of Quiet Channels after the assessment is player-known.

values.guidance: A resilient, bounded, accountable civilian communications route is actually established as the Quiet Channels Network.
The immediate network problem receives a useful but materially limited disposition without the full asset.
The assignment materially fails after known trust, security, or authority risks are deliberately mishandled.

exclusions: Selecting, delegating, authorizing one contact, resolving one favor, or declaring the network safe does not establish the result.

interpretation.guidance: Claim only when Mara Venn presents a real favor, verification gap, or insecure traffic obligation that forces Priya's network into an accountable boundary. If Medical Supply Accountability is active, it may sharpen the scrutiny but never makes Quiet Channels the source of redline.
exclusions: One harmless contact, generalized suspicion, a Pale Lantern theory, or an assertion that the network supplied redline is not the complication.

interpretation.guidance: Record only an explicit decision to conclude the interval after exactly two assignments have actual resolved dispositions.

values.guidance: The player explicitly concludes the normal two-assignment interval.

exclusions: The second result occurring does not auto-close the interval; an explicit conclusion is required.

interpretation.guidance: Record only an explicit decision to conclude after all three assignments resolve and at least one was credibly delegated.

values.guidance: All three assignments resolved with delegation preventing automatic overextension.

exclusions: Delegating an assignment before its result, or resolving all three directly, does not establish broad delegated coverage.

interpretation.guidance: Record only an explicit interval conclusion after all three assignments resolved under direct command, carrying the known overextension cost.

values.guidance: All three direct-command assignments resolved and the interval closes overextended.

exclusions: Selecting all three, resolving only two, or delegating one does not establish direct-command overextension.

interpretation.guidance: Record only an explicit decision to end Open Orders I before completing the normal assignment load, with the unfinished opportunity cost understood.

values.guidance: The player explicitly ends the interval early and accepts that local opportunities remain unfinished.

exclusions: Ignoring an assignment for a scene, asking about Chapter 3, or ordinary travel discussion does not end the interval.

playerText.title: The Breckenridge leaves local work unfinished
playerText.summary: The campaign continues with the deliberately unfinished Open Orders opportunities carried forward.

playerText.title: Broad work at an overextended pace
playerText.summary: All three assignments were carried under direct command, and the resulting fatigue or delayed investigation is recorded.

playerText.title: Useful work closes with a serious limitation
playerText.summary: The interval produced local value while an informed assignment failure remains part of the campaign record.

playerText.title: Practical resilience built in the Reach
playerText.summary: At least two local assignments produced durable capabilities while the wider investigation continued.

playerText.title: Work worth doing
playerText.summary: The Breckenridge completed a responsible local work program with its limits and obligations recorded.

target.playerSafeSetup: Rowan and Priya have correlated the preserved Hecate traffic well enough for Whitaker to order a mission into the Drift.

mustNarrate: Acknowledge only the assignments actually resolved, declined, or left unfinished.
Carry forward earned local capabilities only when the corresponding V1 result is assetEarned.
Carry forward overextension or early departure when recorded.
Explain that background analysis has matured the weak Hecate trace into the next mission without making the player manage that analysis as another checklist.
mustNotReveal: Do not imply completion of an unselected, declined, or unresolved assignment.
Do not identify Pale Lantern, Holt's wider role, or the source inside the Hecate Drift.
Do not erase assignment limits, failure, overextension, or unfinished local obligations.
